upstream_metadata.description: Pre-trained vectors based on Wikipedia 2014 + Gigaword 5.6B tokens, 400K vocab, uncased (https://nlp.stanford.edu/projects/glove/).
upstream_metadata.preprocessing: Converted to w2v format with `python -m gensim.scripts.glove2word2vec -i <fname> -o glove-wiki-gigaword-100.txt`.

special_tokens: PAD zero; BOS/EOS original random; CBOW UNK trained when observed, otherwise original random; public UNK original random.
fallback: Keep original baseline random vectors for missing tokens; freeze all rows.
